deep_review.conclusion: Inventory is complete. Any reuse requires affirmative speaker consent, provenance/disclosure and anti-impersonation policy; model quality and runtime safeguards were not tested.

semantic_review_progress.scoped_deep_review: Voice-identity trigger reviewed narrowly. The implementation creates a voice representation from a few seconds of audio and generates arbitrary speech; the source does not establish speaker consent, provenance marking or misuse controls. It is also explicitly described as an aging research implementation.

repository_intelligence.purpose: Python SV2TTS research implementation that synthesizes speech in a target voice from a short reference sample using speaker encoding, text synthesis and a vocoder.
repository_intelligence.reuse_recommendation: Research reference only until license and model provenance are established; use voice samples only with informed consent.
repository_intelligence.inspection_scope: Bounded review of pinned README; capability clusters describe repository-level reuse, not an exhaustive asset inventory.
repository_intelligence.license_notes: No SPDX license assertion in GitHub metadata; inspect repository notices and model artifacts before reuse.
risk_notes: Voice cloning enables impersonation; license uncertainty, consent, provenance and synthetic-media disclosure require review.
